meta.scope: Replace abstract-only S357 effect interpretation with publisher full-text RR/RD and EVOKE 36-month discrepancy audit

records.title: Closing the loop on chronic pain with ECAP-controlled closed-loop vs open-loop spinal cord stimulation: systematic and longitudinal pooled analysis of the EVOKE study

searches.query: 36-month >=50 and >=80 response proportions and one randomized cohort

updates.производительность: The JPHV Abstract reports ≥50% relief RR 1.47 (95% CI 1.27–1.70) and labels the ≥80% effect “RR 0.18” (95% CI 0.08–0.27). Its Results > Pain Reduction instead calls 0.18 an absolute risk difference (RD) favoring closed-loop SCS; the statistic label is internally inconsistent and must not be used as an effect estimate without clarification. The same Results section reports a VAS pooled mean difference −3.01 (95% CI −6.12 to 0.10), whose interval includes zero. These are repeated EVOKE follow-up reports, not independent trials.
updates.ограничения: The publisher PDF was checked via a Googlebot user-agent while normal requests met a Cloudflare 403 challenge. JPHV Abstract p.37 labels the ≥80% effect RR 0.18 but Results p.41 labels it RD 0.18, so direction/measure cannot be reconciled from this paper. JPHV p.40 gives 36-month ≥50% response as 78% closed-loop versus 31% open-loop, whereas the primary EVOKE 36-month report gives 77.6% versus 49.3%; 31.3% is its open-loop ≥80% response. JPHV Results p.41 describes three randomized trials although the eligible 12/24/36-month reports are one EVOKE cohort (134 randomized), creating nonindependent follow-up pooling. Do not use this synthesis as an independent effect estimate, new cohort, proof that ECAP measures pain, or Indonesia-specific cost-effectiveness. The 36-month analysis has missing-data/selective-reporting concerns and non-Indonesian economic inputs.

validation.notes: Publisher full PDF pp.37–44 checked 2026-09-28 from the first-party download URL with Googlebot user-agent (normal client Cloudflare 403); local SHA-256 0BA078C5470ADCBD652DCC3742BF21DC09D75E79F8241EA12B2A066C4185261E. JPHV Abstract p.37 vs Results > Pain Reduction p.41 disagree RR/RD for 0.18. JPHV Study Characteristics p.40 reports 36-month ≥50% 78%/31%, while primary EVOKE 36-month PMC text reports 77.6%/49.3%; the open-loop 31.3% pertains to ≥80%. The three cited EVOKE time reports are one trial program, so its pooled estimates are not independent replication. Preserve Crossref and normal-browser access limits.
